body: I don't see my Path of Willpower in the UI, is that missing?

It isn't missing, just hidden for now. Nala has the Path of Willpower, but it's marked as not yet revealed, because her Status hasn't opened. That's what "Status withheld" meant, so her Paths and stats don't show on the sheet yet. Your kick in turn 3 is the answer to that. When her Status opens, they'll appear. The roll in turn 2 named the Path because the dice used it.

Correction to what I said earlier: opening her Status won't show the Path of Willpower. It hasn't opened for her yet, so it stays hidden after her Status opens. The turn 2 roll counted it at +0, so it added nothing.
